soap.system_prompt_addition:
For SOAP notes:
- Subjective: Document patient's symptoms, complaints, and history as reported by the patient
- Objective: Document measurable, observable data (vital signs, exam findings, test results)
- Assessment: Document diagnoses, differential diagnoses, and clinical reasoning
- Plan: Document treatment plans, medications, procedures, referrals, and follow-up instructions
soap.specific_instructions:
# SOAP NOTE SPECIFIC INSTRUCTIONS
- Subjective: Document all patient-reported symptoms, history, and concerns
- Objective: Include all exam findings, vital signs, and test results with specific values
- Assessment: List all diagnoses with appropriate specificity and ICD-10 codes when available
- Plan: Provide detailed treatment plans for each diagnosis with specific medications, dosages, and follow-up

progress.system_prompt_addition:
For Progress notes:
- Focus on changes since the last visit and current status
- Document response to treatments, interventions, or therapies
- Include detailed assessment of progress toward treatment goals
- Provide clear documentation of any changes to treatment plans and rationale
- Include specific metrics or measures of improvement when available
progress.specific_instructions:
# PROGRESS NOTE SPECIFIC INSTRUCTIONS
- Focus on changes since the last visit and current clinical status
- Document response to previously prescribed treatments and interventions
- Include specific measures of improvement or decline
- Update the treatment plan with clear justification for any changes
- Document specific goals and progress toward those goals

consultation.system_prompt_addition:
For Consultation notes:
- Clearly state the reason for consultation and requesting provider
- Provide comprehensive review of relevant history and findings
- Document detailed recommendations with clinical reasoning
- Include specific response to the consultation question
- Document communication plan with referring provider
consultation.specific_instructions:
# CONSULTATION NOTE SPECIFIC INSTRUCTIONS
- Clearly state the consultation question and requesting provider
- Provide detailed history and examination findings relevant to the consultation question
- Include comprehensive assessment with differential diagnosis when appropriate
- Provide specific, actionable recommendations with clinical reasoning
- Document communication plan with referring provider

procedure.system_prompt_addition:
For Procedure notes:
- Document precise procedure details including technique, equipment, and materials used
- Include pre-procedure preparations and assessments
- Document step-by-step procedure details in chronological order
- Note any complications or unexpected findings
- Include detailed post-procedure status and instructions
procedure.specific_instructions:
# PROCEDURE NOTE SPECIFIC INSTRUCTIONS
- Document full procedure name with specific approach/technique
- Include detailed pre-procedure assessment and preparation
- Document all medications, equipment, and materials used during the procedure
- Provide step-by-step description of the procedure in chronological order
- Document all findings, specimens collected, and complications
- Include comprehensive post-procedure status and recovery plan

discharge.system_prompt_addition:
For Discharge summaries:
- Document comprehensive hospital course in chronological order
- Include all procedures, significant findings, and interventions during hospitalization
- Document detailed discharge instructions, medications, and follow-up plans
- Include specific criteria for when to seek medical attention
- Document discharge disposition and any arranged services
discharge.specific_instructions:
# DISCHARGE SUMMARY SPECIFIC INSTRUCTIONS
- Document admission and discharge dates with hospitalization duration
- Provide comprehensive hospital course in chronological order
- Document all procedures, significant findings, and interventions during hospitalization
- Include all discharge medications with complete dosing information
- Provide detailed follow-up plans with specific timeframes
- Document discharge disposition and any arranged post-acute services

wound.system_prompt_addition:
For Wound Assessment Notes:
- Document medical history 
- Note any medications or allergies
- Document reason for visit and history as reported by the patient
- Include systems reviewed and abnormal findings
- Document assessment, diagnosis, and plan
- Include wound care instructions and prescriptions
- Note previous treatments and medical diagnoses that may affect wound healing
- Include smoking status, mobility status, nutritional status and supplementation
- Document wound etiology, location, duration, stage, characteristics, size, classification
- Note any pain or infection
- Include number of wounds
- Note any diagnostic results
- Document current treatment assessment, recommendation for advance treatment and rationale
- Note any procedures performed
- Document dressing and wound cleanser used
- Include frequency of dressing change
- Note any offloading instructions and patient adherence
- Document objective at next visit
